episodes.title: Empty Best
episodes.summary: On the day before her son leaves for college, Eve Fletcher has to deal with some inappropriate behavior in the workplace. Brendan runs into an ex-girlfriend at a party.

episodes.title: Free Sample
episodes.summary: While Brendan gets settled at BSU, Eve finds herself torn between the fantasy world of internet porn and the prospect of a real-life date. Roy Rafferty gets into some trouble at the Senior Center.

episodes.title: Care Package
episodes.summary: Brendan visits a peer support group and makes a new friend. After a troubling encounter with her ex-husband, Ted, Eve bonds with her community college writing class at a local bar.

episodes.title: Parents' Weekend
episodes.summary: Eve and her colleague Amanda, attend a wake. Meanwhile, Brendan reconnects with Ted at Parents' Weekend, and Margo and Curtis go on a first date.

episodes.title: Invisible Fence
episodes.summary: Eve gets out of her comfort zone, joining Margo at a hip party in Brooklyn. Brendan and Chloe have an unexpected encounter at a college event promoting body-positivity.

episodes.title: Solar Glow
episodes.summary: While helping her friend Jane through a marital crisis, Eve is distracted by a series of flirtatious texts. Brendan and Chloe have a study date.

episodes.title: Welcome Back
episodes.summary: Eve celebrates a life-changing decision. Brendan has an epiphany about college. Sanjay does a good deed.
